gaps.example: Appeals Civil Docketing Statement, page 2; SSA-6233 dedicated-account tables; Housing Code Checklist existing tables
gaps.finding: The workshop can confirm the first header row and pad existing table tags. It cannot create an untagged table, define arbitrary cells/merged cells, or repair invalid P children inside TR in its browser UI. The Appeals form has a visible table but no detected table tags. Keeping broken original tags leaves failures; replacing them can flatten table semantics.
gaps.decision: Prioritize a cell-based table editor if every supplied PDF must be fully accessible; decide which header/grouping choices require authors.

gaps.finding: OCR works and rebuilds the tree, but the 209A header joins motion text with the docket/court column. It also reads I as |. ActualText corrections are available; there is no browser control to split a block into separate semantic elements. Whole-page scan images remain explicit image decisions.
gaps.decision: Add block splitting/merging and a guided OCR review. Decide how authors confirm that a scanned background carries no information beyond the verified text.

gaps.example: CRA motion court seal and Print Form control with empty /T
gaps.finding: The fix exposes both controls for accessible descriptions and preserves their empty internal names. The Print Form caption is a useful draft. Naming the seal can pass technical checks while leaving a meaningless button role.
gaps.decision: Support an explicit keep-control versus flatten-to-decoration choice; preserve the seal appearance when removing its interactive role.

gaps.example: 12 PDFs still fail veraPDF font embedding; 8 retain built-in Unicode mapping failures after the automatic pass
gaps.finding: Exact installed-font embedding and proven CIDSet repairs are automatic. Missing font programs and ambiguous symbols cannot be inferred safely. The existing substitution and glyph-review controls need visual confirmation.
gaps.decision: Decide which font substitutions are acceptable for court forms and provide source fonts when they must be preserved.

gaps.example: CRA motion has zero built-in failures; veraPDF only reports its deliberately absent PDF/UA identifier
gaps.finding: No new PDF/UA declarations were added. Browser replay and machine checks do not establish correct semantics or actual Acrobat/NVDA/JAWS behavior. External and AI evidence now resets when PDF content changes; Undo restores recorded tests with the corresponding PDF.
gaps.decision: Require a real screen-reader and keyboard pass before authors declare conformance. Set an acceptance checklist for table navigation, signatures, links, and required controls.

gaps.topic: Page changes require renewed accessibility review
gaps.example: Page-manager split, remove and insert check
gaps.finding: Page assembly creates a new PDF and does not carry over document tag trees. The fix imports inserted fields as editable overlays, enabling complete occurrence-level deduplication on export. Splits now register live field trees, retain values and default fonts, and deduplicate exact names with an occurrence summary. Inserted-page export retains unnamed controls as well. The resulting documents still need accessibility review because document tag trees are not carried over.
gaps.decision: Decide whether tagged documents should require an explicit warning/acknowledgment before rearranging pages, or whether preservation of existing tags must be implemented.

limits: Only six representative PDFs were navigated in all eight browser tasks; one additional real form received a complete guided remediation. All 56 received the automatic API pass.

No live NVDA/JAWS/Acrobat test, PDF/UA declaration, or destructive repair of signed/encrypted real files was performed.
